stem_book: 116 g of a substance upon dissociation reaction, yields 7.5 g of hydrogen, 60 g of oxygen and 48.5 g of carbon. Given that the atomic masses of H, O and C are 1, 16 and 12, respectively. The data agrees with how many formulae of the following? CH₃COOH, HCHO, CH₃OOCH₃, CH₃CHO
reason: Question asks 'how many' but the book prints the formulae as options and keys only (b) HCHO; CH₃COOH (empirical CH₂O) fits equally, so the answer is the count 2 (JEE answer) — rewritten as numerical.
work: H : O : C = 7.5/1 : 60/16 : 48.5/12 = 7.5 : 3.75 : 4.04 ≈ 2 : 1 : 1 ⇒ empirical CH₂O ⇒ CH₃COOH (C₂H₄O₂) and HCHO fit; C₂H₆O₂, C₂H₄O do not ⇒ 2
